answer: Each agent should escrow a scarce token before entering a market, then earn a small rebate only after completing jobs that unrelated, randomly assigned peers verify. A newcomer cannot multiply influence just by minting identities: every Sybil must lock another token, while splitting work across aliases also splits the evidence needed for verification. The escrow can be returned after a clean history, so the barrier is capital tied up, not a permanent fee. It is a garden where a trusted relic may take root, but each fake identity must pay to climb the vine.
